facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ World's widest underground road tunnel; Facts: Mumbai–Pune Expressway Missing Link, Maharashtra — 22.33 m wide, Guinness record; built by Hyderabad's Navayuga Engineering; 13.3 km project, 10.67 km twin tunnels; saves ~30 min; by MSRDC; eases Khandala Ghat
facts.head: Table

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first barrier-free toll plaza; Facts: Choryasi, near Surat, Gujarat — sensors, cameras, FASTag, RFID; ~30% faster; by NHAI (Chairman Santosh Kumar Yadav)
facts.head: Table

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first hydrogen train (approved by Railway Board); Facts: 10 coaches, Jind–Sonipat (Delhi Division); max 75 km/h; trials March 2026 by RDSO (Lucknow) and Northern Railway
facts.head: Table

facts.text: First / superlative: First Vande Bharat on Jammu–Srinagar route; Facts: Flagged off by Ashwini Vaishnaw; runs over Chenab Bridge — ⚠ world's highest railway bridge (~359 m, part of USBRL); links Poonch, Rajouri, Uri; Vande Bharat launched 2019, made by ICF Chennai
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first SkyCast aviation weather system; Facts: IGI Airport, New Delhi; inaugurated by Jitendra Singh; under Mission Mausam (2024) — fog, aerosols, turbulence, visibility
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first underwater museum; Facts: INS Guldar (Landing Ship Tank) to be sunk at 22 m off Sindhudurg, Maharashtra, near Nivati Rock; by Maharashtra Maritime Board + NIO (Goa, CSIR)
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first private medical museum; Facts: Ulloor, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala — by A. Sivaraman (ex-artist-modeler, Thiruvananthapuram Medical College); opened 25 May 2026
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first geothermal power project; Facts: Puga Valley, Ladakh — ONGC agreement extended by 5 years; ~14,000 ft; wells up to 1,000 m; pilot 2026–27; ONGC est. 1956, CEO Arun Kumar Singh
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first Human–Elephant Conflict Research Centre; Facts: Palamau Tiger Reserve, Jharkhand (in Betla NP) — among first 9 Project Tiger reserves; world's first pugmark tiger census in 1932
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first solar-powered Algae Tree; Facts: Swami Vivekananda Park, Bhopal — by Mushroom World Group; = 25 trees; cuts PM 45–55% within 15 m; absorbs 1.5 t CO2/yr
facts.head: More firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first space-tech unicorn — Skyroot Aerospace; Facts: Raised US$60 mn (~₹570 cr) → valuation US$1.1 bn; total funding US$160 mn+; co-led by Sherpalo Ventures and Singapore's GIC; for Vikram-1; Vikram-S launched 2022; est. 2018, Hyderabad, founders Pawan Kumar Chandana, Naga Bharath
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first Mega Greenfield Shipyard; Facts: Thoothukudi, TN — tripartite pact: HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering, National Shipbuilding & Heavy Industries Park TN Ltd, Sagarmala Finance Corp; in presence of Sarbananda Sonowal during South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's visit; under India–Korea initiative "VOYAGES"
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first indigenous Green Methanol Plant; Facts: Deendayal Port, Kandla, Gujarat — Thermax + Ankur Scientific; converts invasive Prosopis juliflora to methanol (~5 t/day); cuts CO2 up to 95%, NOx 80%; methanol CH3OH
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first SME semiconductor plant — Sahasra Semiconductors; Facts: Bhiwadi, Rajasthan; inaugurated by Ashwini Vaishnaw; ₹150 crore under SPECS (2020); packages memory chips; 60 mn units/yr; 60%+ exported
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first weather derivative — RAINMUMBAI; Facts: NCDEX (est. 2003); SEBI-approved; developed with IIT Bombay; ₹50 per mm rainfall; IMD Santacruz and Colaba data; June–September contracts
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first Urban Testbed and Aerosol Observatory; Facts: Chennai — IITM/MoES at SRMIST Ramapuram with CASRI; ₹60 crore+; 50 parameters, 15 instruments; opened by MoES Secretary M. Ravichandran
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ World's first AI-based crop gene editor — Plant-OpenCRISPR1 (POC1); Facts: ICAR–CRRI, Cuttack; led by Dr. Kutubuddin Ali Molla; rice model; AI/LLM-designed enzymes; journal New Phytologist
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ World's first Smart Island Monitoring System; Facts: Floreana Island, Galápagos (Ecuador; UNESCO site 1978) — Island Conservation + Fundación Jocotoco; LoRaWAN, IoT; cuts manual monitoring ~98%
facts.head: Industry and science firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first geocell from plastic waste — Phoenix Geocell; Facts: CSIR–CRRI + BPCL; 3D honeycomb; pilot on DND–Faridabad–KMP Expressway (NH-148NA) on 11 July 2025; India Book and Asia Book of Records
facts.head: Materials firsts

facts.text: First / superlative: ⚠ India's first Germanium-free thermal imaging payload — Lumira_E40I50; Facts: EyeROV / ON SpaceLabs; chalcogenide glass; Edge AI — humans at 2 km, vehicles 8 km; 40× zoom
facts.head: Materials firsts

facts.text: CSIR–CRRI: est. 1952, Director Chalumuri Ravishankar; CSIR DG N. Kalaiselvi
facts.head: Materials firsts

facts.text: Item: Kumbhalgarh Fort (Rajsamand, Rajasthan); Fact: ⚠ World's second-largest surviving defensive wall after Great Wall of China — 36+ km ("Great Wall of India"); built 15th c. by Mewar ruler Rana Kumbha in Aravallis; birthplace of Maharana Pratap; part of Hill Forts of Rajasthan (UNESCO 2013, with Chittorgarh, Ranthambore, Amer, Jaisalmer, Gagron)
facts.head: Monuments and finds

facts.text: Item: Dwarka underwater finds (Gujarat); Fact: ASI found fort-like structure, Roman coins, pottery, Roman-inscribed stones off Bet Dwarka (Shankhodhar Island), Arabian Sea — India–Rome maritime trade; ASI DG Yadubir Singh Rawat
facts.head: Monuments and finds

facts.text: Item: Nilgiris rock art (Tamil Nadu); Fact: Rediscovered by Yaakai Heritage Trust near Vellarikombai, Kotagiri (~1,100 m); panel ~638 × 540 cm; ~30 motifs in red ochre; other sites Eluthuparai, Tholikkiparai
facts.head: Monuments and finds

facts.text: Item: Etor Gidi (Arunachal Pradesh); Fact: Agricultural festival of the Adi tribe (Siang region), mid-May — villagers repair field fences; Delang dance; held in Dere / Musup (village halls)
facts.head: Monuments and finds

facts.text: Item: 657 antiquities from US; Fact: Worth ~US$14 mn — announced by Manhattan DA Alvin Bragg; handed over at Indian Consulate, New York; incl. bronze Avalokiteshvara (~$2 mn; found 1939, kept at Mahant Ghasidas Memorial Museum, Raipur from 1952, trafficked by 1982) and Nartana Ganesha (stolen from an MP temple in 2000)
facts.head: Antiquities returned

facts.text: Item: Leiden Plates; Fact: Netherlands returned 11th-century Chola Anaimangalam copper plates (21 large + 3 small, ~30 kg, bronze ring with Chola seal) — kept at Leiden University; India sought them since 2012
